src: complete two-color template in the upper-left interior block plus sparse control pixels in the other interior blocks
dst: the four equal blocks of the bordered interior
transform: fill the upper-left block with the template, upper-right with its horizontal reflection, lower-left with its vertical reflection, and lower-right with both reflections; recolor each transformed template by the local control pixels, leaving unmapped template symbols as background
symbol_instructions: within each target block, a control pixel gives the output color for the transformed template symbol at that same relative position
